move-a-spec-forward: A running converge shows in flight on the entry that carries implement's progress
read-a-spec: A spec has one viewer tab

review-a-living-spec: A living spec opens as a capability, not as a run
Approve all and Remove can be undone for five seconds
work-through-a-document: The viewer keeps the reader's place
webview-safety: Text from outside is read as words, never as markup
Text from outside never lands inside a tag through string building
A link that points at a script does nothing
act-on-a-spec: Hover and right-click offer the same menu, filtered to what applies
Several specs can be changed in one action
Resume hands the spec back to the assistant from where it stopped
browse-specs: Specs are grouped by lifecycle, each group with a live count
A spec row says where the spec stands without relying on color
Expanding a spec lists its pipeline's documents, each with its own state
Clicking a row opens it in the spec viewer
One toolbar button collapses or expands every spec row
The tree follows the files on disk
keep-living-specs-current: Checks and syncs are handed to the assistant, scoped to where they were launched
see-changes-from-disk: The folders in `speckit.specDirectories` are the ones watched
keep-the-companion-extension-current: A missing extension is pointed out wherever the user would need it
open-the-sidebar: The container shows the views the workspace and settings call for
An empty Specs view offers exactly one next step
The Specs toolbar holds the same actions in the same order
A missing Companion extension is flagged until it is installed
set-up-and-update: Start-up offers the next missing setup step
browse-steering-files: Authoring actions ask the assistant to do the writing
Only steering documents can be refined or deleted from the tree
find-a-living-spec: The view walks a new project from nothing to a first capability
produce-the-docs-media: A change to what the screens look like runs the whole chain

intent: Show Spec Kit bug reports (.specify/bugs/<slug>/) in the sidebar and open them read-only in the spec viewer

decisions.decision: Bugs group inside the Specs view, after Archived
decisions.why: Specs view already groups work items; no container or toolbar change; bugs have no number or lifecycle so they stay out of lifecycle groups

decisions.decision: Specs filter applies to bugs; sort does not
decisions.why: a filter that ignored bugs would hide the No specs match clear-filter welcome

decisions.decision: New read-only bug mode beside living mode in the viewer
decisions.why: living mode hides the rail and adds living footer/renderer; the plain spec path backfills .spec-context.json
decisions.rejected: reuse living mode or the spec path

decisions.decision: Allow-list of read messages for bug panels plus data-read-only on the page
decisions.why: toggleCheckbox/editLine/removeLine write the file; one gate is checkable

decisions.decision: Parse the real bug extension v1.0.0 format: bold-label header bullets, no front matter
decisions.why: read from installed command files and a real headless run

decisions.decision: Checkbox gate on a read-only page uses isReadOnlyPage(), not isReadOnly()
decisions.why: isReadOnly() is also true for completed/archived specs, which must keep ticking per work-through-a-document

decisions.decision: show() opens any .specify/bugs report path read-only even without the bug flag
decisions.why: openFile and other callers that open a report path must never fall into the spec path that backfills .spec-context.json
decisions.rejected: trust every caller to pass { bug: true }

decisions.decision: The install CTA row only shows when specs exist
decisions.why: open-the-sidebar ties the pinned row to a tree with specs; a bugs-only tree keeps that contract
decisions.rejected: show the CTA above a lone Bugs group

decisions.decision: Bug folder containment is checked on the real path
decisions.why: a symlinked folder under .specify/bugs could otherwise point outside it
decisions.rejected: string check on the folder name

plan.summary: Bugs group in the Specs tree plus a read-only bug mode in the viewer, one parser module, one watcher
plan.key_finding: The normal viewer path writes a backfill .spec-context.json on first open, so bugs need their own mode, and checkbox/line edits write the file unless blocked
